title: The lead comes first and each technician shows only once
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Esther Howard) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example Ralph Edwards) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17606) for customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Lead First Once") is led by {Technician-A} and has three approved lines: {Line-1} (for example "Service - Full grease service") given to {Technician-A}, and {Line-2} (for example "Service - Adjust clutch") and {Line-3} (for example "Replace - Brake pot") both given to {Technician-B}.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  3. Click Fields to display, turn line technicians on and close the menu.
  4. Read the avatars on the {Work-order-1} card in order.
  5. Hover each avatar and read the name shown.
  6. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  7. Click the Column Selection button and make sure Assigned Techs is on (it is on by default; turn it on if it was turned off), then close the menu.
  8. Read the avatars in {Work-order-1}'s Assigned Techs cell in order.
  9. Hover each avatar and read the name shown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 4 and 5: the group shows 2 avatars: {Technician-A} first, then {Technician-B}.
  • Steps 4 and 5: {Technician-A} appears once although they are the lead and on {Line-1}, and {Technician-B} appears once although they are on {Line-2} and {Line-3}.
  • Steps 8 and 9: Tech View's Assigned Techs cell shows the same 2 avatars, {Technician-A} first, each once.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10050 (Story 7, Show line technicians on cards and rows); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S7-R3, S7-R5, S7-E1 and S7-R7 (S7-R7 rewritten in version 51 on 14 Oct 2026 (Chris Ward ruling after Sasha Grosman's staging review: Tech View's default columns are the design's 13, and Assigned Techs is on by default); the Tech View step now only makes sure Assigned Techs is on, the expected results are unchanged), read 14 Oct 2026. Review Decisions FF-8 / DR-11. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R3: “Place the lead technician first in the avatar group.”
  • S7-R5: “Show each technician once, even when they are both lead and assigned to lines.”
  • S7-E1: “A technician assigned to several lines of the same work order appears once.”
  • S7-R7: “In Tech View the Assigned Techs column sits immediately after Lines, matching the design. It is on by default (S5-R4) and can be removed through the column chooser (S2-R4).”

AUTOMATION: READY
